preconditions: Asynchronous lifecycle, double free, or aliased pointer reuse

rules.explanation: Pointer accessed or dereferenced after free() without nullification in C.
rules.lesson: Distinguish object lifetime from transaction visibility; set pointers to NULL immediately after free.
rules.title: Use After Free / Lifetime Invariant Violation (C/C++)

rules.explanation: Raw pointer or resource accessed after deallocation or drop in Rust.
rules.lesson: Enforce Rust ownership invariants or invalidate raw pointers immediately upon manual deallocation.
rules.title: Use After Free / Dereference After Drop or Deallocation (Rust)

preconditions: Unchecked return value from allocator or lookup function

rules.explanation: Pointer dereferenced immediately after allocation without NULL check in C.
rules.lesson: Always verify pointer return values against NULL before dereferencing.
rules.title: Unchecked Return Value / NULL Pointer Dereference (C/C++)

rules.explanation: Raw pointer dereferenced in unsafe block without is_null() guard in Rust.
rules.lesson: Validate raw pointers with .is_null() before dereferencing in unsafe blocks, or use NonNull.
rules.title: Unchecked Raw Pointer Dereference (Rust)

families_without_evidence.reason_no_evidence: no 40-hex fix commit for this CWE in docs/memory/records or docs/studies/cve-history

rules.explanation: Dynamic command string passed to system(), popen(), or shell exec() in C without sanitization.
rules.lesson: Use parameterized execv/execve with discrete arguments array instead of shell invocation.
rules.title: OS Command Injection in C (system / popen / exec)

rules.explanation: Executing commands via shell=True, os.system, os.popen, or dynamic exec() with unsanitized input.
rules.lesson: Pass arguments as a sequence without shell=True; use ast.literal_eval instead of eval/exec.
rules.title: OS Command Injection in Python (subprocess shell=True / os.system / exec)

rules.explanation: Unsanitized variables passed to eval, sh -c, or exec in shell script.
rules.lesson: Avoid eval; use direct binary execution and strictly quote/validate all external parameters.
rules.title: Command Injection / Unquoted Evaluation in Shell

preconditions: Untrusted buffer length or unbounded string processing
families_without_evidence.reason_no_evidence: no 40-hex fix commit for this CWE in docs/memory/records or docs/studies/cve-history

rules.explanation: Unbounded string function (strcpy, strcat, gets, sprintf) prone to classic stack/heap buffer overflow.
rules.lesson: Replace with bounds-checked alternatives (strncpy, strlcat, fgets, snprintf) and validate buffer bounds.
rules.title: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input (C/C++)

families_without_evidence.reason_no_evidence: no 40-hex fix commit for this CWE in docs/memory/records or docs/studies/cve-history

rules.explanation: Multiplication or addition inside allocation argument without bound or overflow check in C.
rules.lesson: Use overflow-checked helpers (e.g. check_mul_overflow, calloc) or explicit bounds validation before allocation.
rules.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound in Allocation (C/C++)

rules.explanation: Unchecked arithmetic inside allocation size or capacity in Rust.
rules.lesson: Use checked_mul() or checked_add() before computing collection capacity or layout size.
rules.title: Integer Overflow in Allocation / Capacity (Rust)

families_without_evidence.cluster_title: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource (Race Condition)
preconditions: Multithreaded / interrupt context without adequate lock barrier
families_without_evidence.reason_no_evidence: no 40-hex fix commit for this CWE in docs/memory/records or docs/studies/cve-history

rules.explanation: TOCTOU check-then-open pattern or rapid unlock-relock window in C creates concurrency race window.
rules.lesson: Use atomic open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, or hold critical section invariants continuously.
rules.title: Race Condition / TOCTOU Window (C/C++)

rules.explanation: Checking os.path.exists() before open() introduces a TOCTOU race condition in Python.
rules.lesson: Use atomic file operations (e.g. open with 'x' mode) or try/except FileExistsError/FileNotFoundError.
rules.title: Race Condition / TOCTOU File Access (Python)

rules.explanation: Testing file existence before operating on it in shell creates a TOCTOU race condition.
rules.lesson: Use atomic file operations or mktemp; handle command error codes directly.
rules.title: Race Condition / TOCTOU File Operation (Shell)

selection_rule: A family is emitted when it has at least one auditor rule and at least one 40-hex fix commit in this repository, linked by the row's recorded cwe or by the advisory appearing in the family cluster's sample_cves. At most 3 citations per family: pack records before catalog rows, then advisory id, lowest-sorting SHA per advisory.
